sections.title: 紹介状と費用・予約は別に確認する

paragraphs.text: 国の徴収義務の対象は、特定機能病院や一般病床２００床以上の地域医療支援病院・紹介受診重点医療機関などです。医科の最低額は初診７千円、対象となる再診３千円で、歯科は異なります。これは通常の自己負担とは別の料金です。施設の実際の総額や適用条件は事前に確認します。
紹介受診重点医療機関は、専門的な外来医療を紹介患者中心に担う施設で、紹介状がないこと自体で一律に受診禁止になる制度ではありません。一方、紹介状なしの受診では特別料金が原則必要です。「大病院」という呼び方だけで判断せず、都道府県の指定情報と受診先の案内を確認します。

sections.title: 逆紹介で引き継ぐ内容

paragraphs.text: 紹介状を受け取ったら予約も済んだと考えず、予約を誰が取るのか、持参資料は何かを確認します。岩国医療センターの案内では紹介元の申込みと予約票の発行が別途あり、受診時には紹介状等を持参します。これは施設ごとの手順の一例であり、他院でも同じとは限りません。
逆紹介は、病状が安定した後の診療を地域の医療機関へ引き継ぐ仕組みです。福井大学病院では複数科に通院中でも安定した診療科を対象としています。引継ぎ時には次の受診先と予約方法、処方・検査を担当する医療機関を確認し、紹介状を受け渡すだけで連携が完了したと思わないことが大切です。

sections.title: Check fees and booking separately from the letter

paragraphs.text: Mandatory special charges cover specified hospitals, including advanced-treatment hospitals and regional support or referral-focused hospitals with at least 200 general beds. The medical-care minimum is ¥7,000 for an initial visit and ¥3,000 for qualifying repeat visits; dentistry differs. These are separate from ordinary copayments. Confirm the facility's actual total and eligibility conditions.

Referral-focused institutions provide specialist outpatient services primarily for referred patients. Their designation does not itself impose a universal ban on visits without a letter, although a special charge normally applies. The label “large hospital” is insufficient to determine the rules: check prefectural designation information and the receiving hospital's instructions.

sections.title: Plan the return referral

paragraphs.text: Receiving a referral letter does not necessarily mean an appointment has been booked. Check who makes the booking and what documents to bring. Iwakuni Medical Center, for example, describes a separate referral request and appointment slip, with the letter brought on the day. This illustrates a local procedure, not a nationwide booking rule.

A return referral transfers ongoing care to a community provider once the relevant condition is stable. Fukui University Hospital notes that this can concern a stable specialty even while other specialties continue care. Clarify the receiving provider, booking arrangements and responsibility for medicines and tests rather than treating delivery of the letter as a completed handover.

sections.title: 转诊信、费用与预约分别确认

paragraphs.text: 国家规定必须收取特别费用的对象包括特定功能医院，以及普通病床达200张的地域医疗支援医院、重点接收转诊患者的医院等。医科初诊最低7,000日元，符合条件的复诊最低3,000日元，牙科另有规定。这笔费用与通常自付额分开，实际总额及适用条件需向机构确认。
重点接收转诊患者的机构主要承担专业门诊服务。被列为此类机构，并不意味着一律禁止无转诊信就诊，但原则上涉及特别费用。不能只凭“大医院”的称呼判断，应同时核对都道府县公布的机构名单与医院就诊说明。

sections.title: 明确回转诊的交接安排

paragraphs.text: 拿到转诊信不代表已经完成预约，应确认由谁预约、当天需要携带哪些资料。例如岩国医疗中心另有转诊申请及预约单签发步骤，就诊时需带转诊信等。这只是机构操作流程的例子，不能推定其他医院完全相同。
回转诊是在病情稳定后，将后续诊疗交接给社区机构的安排。福井大学医院说明，即使同时在多个科室就诊，也可针对已稳定的科室实施。交接时应确认下一家机构、预约方式及处方和检查的负责方，不能把交付转诊信视为全部衔接已完成。

corrections.old: 診断や治療経過、検査結果が記載され、重複検査や行き違いを防ぎます。大病院の初診では紹介状の有無で費用が変わります。
corrections.new: 紹介状は診療情報を受診先へ引き継ぐ文書です。不要な重複検査を減らす助けになりますが、再検査が必要な場合もあります。初診の特別料金は対象病院や受診条件によるため、紹介状と予約の扱いを確認します。
corrections.reason: The original promises prevention of duplicate testing and implies every large-hospital first-visit fee is determined solely by a referral letter; both are overbroad.

corrections.old: Diagnoses, courses, and test results are written in, preventing duplicate tests and mix-ups. Large-hospital first visits change fees with or without letters.
corrections.new: A referral letter transfers clinical information and can help reduce unnecessary repeat testing, but retesting may still be needed. Special first-visit charges depend on the hospital and circumstances; confirm referral and booking requirements.
corrections.reason: The original promises prevention of duplicate testing and implies every large-hospital first-visit fee is determined solely by a referral letter; both are overbroad.

corrections.old: 记载诊断、治疗经过与检查结果，防止重复检查与出入。大医院初诊有无转诊信费用不同。
corrections.new: 转诊信用于交接诊疗信息，有助于减少不必要的重复检查，但仍可能需要复查。初诊特别费用取决于医院类别及就诊条件，应确认转诊信与预约要求。
corrections.reason: The original promises prevention of duplicate testing and implies every large-hospital first-visit fee is determined solely by a referral letter; both are overbroad.

corrections.old: 紹介状なしの大病院受診では特別料金がかかります。まずは地域の医療機関で相談する流れが基本です。
corrections.new: 紹介状なしで対象病院を受診すると特別料金が原則必要ですが、救急の患者などには徴収しない例外があります。日常の受診先や料金の適用は医療機関に確認しましょう。
corrections.reason: Not every visit to a large hospital without a letter incurs this charge; emergency patients and other defined exceptions must be distinguished.

corrections.old: Visiting large hospitals without referrals costs special fees. Consulting local institutions first is basically the flow.
corrections.new: Covered hospitals normally charge for visits without referrals, but emergency patients and other specified groups are exempt. Confirm routine-care arrangements and fee applicability with the provider.
corrections.reason: Not every visit to a large hospital without a letter incurs this charge; emergency patients and other defined exceptions must be distinguished.

corrections.old: 无转诊信看大医院收特别费用。基本流程先在地区医疗机构商量。
corrections.new: 无转诊信到制度对象医院就诊，原则上需付特别费用，但急救患者等属于豁免对象。日常就诊安排及收费适用条件应向机构确认。
corrections.reason: Not every visit to a large hospital without a letter incurs this charge; emergency patients and other defined exceptions must be distinguished.

corrections.old: 専門治療が一段落したら地域の医療機関へ戻り、経過を見ます。情報が共有されることで切れ目ない対応になります。
corrections.new: 病状が安定したら、担当医と相談して地域の医療機関へ診療を引き継ぐことがあります。次の受診先と時期、処方や検査の担当を確認しましょう。情報共有だけで切れ目ない診療が保証されるわけではありません。
corrections.reason: Information sharing supports continuity but does not guarantee seamless care; return referrals are based on stability and may apply by specialty.

corrections.old: After specialist phases, return to local institutions for follow-up. Shared information enables seamless care.
corrections.new: When the condition is stable, the treating team may transfer follow-up to a community provider. Confirm the next provider and visit timing, and who handles prescriptions and tests. Sharing information alone does not guarantee uninterrupted care.
corrections.reason: Information sharing supports continuity but does not guarantee seamless care; return referrals are based on stability and may apply by specialty.

corrections.old: 专科治疗告一段落后回到地区医疗机构随访。信息共享带来无缝应对。
corrections.new: 病情稳定后，可与负责医生商量将后续诊疗交接给社区机构。应确认下一次就诊的地点与时间，以及处方和检查的负责方。信息共享本身并不保证诊疗不会中断。
corrections.reason: Information sharing supports continuity but does not guarantee seamless care; return referrals are based on stability and may apply by specialty.

Replaced categorical fee and seamless-care claims in every language. Hospital workflows are identified as examples; minimum charges are not presented as the actual price at every facility. The 2022 leaflet's then-planned designation rollout was cross-checked against the current ministry page.

sections.title: 何を、どの形式で受け取るか

paragraphs.text: 開示申請では「何の記録が必要か」を具体的に書きます。中央病院の申請書は、他院診療や保険会社への提出が目的なら、別の手続きによる診療情報提供書や診断書が適切な場合もあると案内しています。記録一式の写し、診療経過の要約、証明用文書を区別し、受取先が必要とするものを確認します。
個人情報保護委員会のＱ＆Ａでは、保有個人データは原則として本人が求めた方法で開示し、その方法が困難な場合等には書面で交付すると説明しています。電子カルテだから紙しか受け取れないとは限りません。保存された修正履歴や付箋情報も対象になり得るため、必要なら範囲を確認します。

sections.title: 開示の限界と費用を確認する

paragraphs.text: 開示は原則ですが、第三者の利益を害するおそれなどについて個別に慎重な判断が必要となる例外があります。全部または一部を拒否する場合、厚生労働省の指針は原則として理由を書面で示し、苦情処理体制も説明するよう求めています。単に申請すれば無条件に全情報を受け取れる制度ではありません。
費用と所要期間は申請先で確認します。中央病院の公表例では、申請手数料と複写等の実施手数料を分け、画像だけの場合には別の扱いがあります。開示決定までの目安は３～４週間ですが、全国一律の期限ではありません。紙・電子媒体・画像のどれが必要かを伝え、見積りと受取方法を確かめます。

sections.title: Specify the records and format

paragraphs.text: Specify exactly which records are needed. The National Cancer Center Hospital's request form notes that a referral document or medical certificate, obtained through a separate procedure, may be more suitable for another hospital or an insurer. Distinguish copies of existing records from a clinical summary or certificate, and check what the recipient needs.

The privacy regulator explains that retained personal data are generally disclosed by the requested method, with paper permitted when that method is difficult or excessively costly. Electronic records do not automatically mean paper-only access. Stored amendment histories or electronic annotations may also fall within scope, so clarify whether relevant material is included.

sections.title: Check disclosure limits, fees and timing

paragraphs.text: Disclosure is the principle, but exceptions such as harm to third-party interests require careful case-by-case assessment. Under the ministry's guidance, refusal of all or part of a request should generally come with written reasons and an explanation of the complaint process. An application therefore does not guarantee unconditional access to every item.

Ask the provider about timing and costs. The National Cancer Center Hospital separately lists request and reproduction charges, with different treatment for image-only requests. Its stated three-to-four-week period is for a disclosure decision, not a nationwide deadline. Specify paper, electronic records or images when asking for an estimate and collection arrangements.

sections.title: 明确记录范围与交付形式

paragraphs.text: 申请公开时应具体写明需要哪些记录。中央医院的申请表说明，为外院诊疗或保险公司提交资料时，另行办理的诊疗信息提供书或诊断书可能更合适。应区分现有记录副本、诊疗经过摘要与证明文件，并确认接收方实际需要的材料。
个人信息保护委员会说明，保有个人数据原则上按本人要求的方式提供；该方式难以实现或费用过高等情况下可用书面交付。因此电子病历并非只能以纸张取得。系统保存的修改历史或便签信息也可能属于范围，可确认所需内容是否包含在申请内。

sections.title: 确认公开范围限制、费用与时间

paragraphs.text: 原则上应提供记录，但涉及可能损害第三方利益等例外时，需要慎重进行个案判断。厚生劳动省指引要求，全部或部分拒绝申请时，原则上应书面说明理由，并介绍投诉处理渠道。因此提出申请并不保证无条件获得所有信息。
费用及所需时间应向受理机构确认。中央医院分别公布申请费和复制等实施费用，只申请影像时另有处理。其所列三至四周是作出公开决定的大致时间，并非全国统一期限。询价及确认领取方式时，应说明需要纸质记录、电子记录还是影像。

corrections.old: 申請書の提出、本人確認、手数料の支払いを経て写しを受け取ります。期間や範囲は施設に確認しましょう。
corrections.new: 施設の手順に沿って申請し、本人または代理人の資格確認を受けます。開示の判断後に閲覧や写しの交付が行われます。費用を徴収する場合は実費を勘案した合理的な範囲とされ、対象資料、方法、期間、費用を窓口で確認します。
corrections.reason: The original reduces disclosure to payment followed by automatic copies; it omits the disclosure decision and treats fees as universal. Fees may be charged within a reasonable cost-based range.

corrections.old: Submit applications, verify identity, and pay fees to receive copies. Confirm periods and scope with institutions.
corrections.new: Apply through the provider's procedure and establish your identity or authority as a representative. Inspection or copies follow the disclosure decision. Any fee should be reasonable in relation to actual costs; confirm scope, format, timing and charges.
corrections.reason: The original reduces disclosure to payment followed by automatic copies; it omits the disclosure decision and treats fees as universal. Fees may be charged within a reasonable cost-based range.

corrections.old: 经提交申请、身份确认与手续费支付拿到复印件。期限范围向机构确认。
corrections.new: 按机构流程申请，并接受本人身份或代理资格确认。在作出公开决定后，可安排查阅或提供副本。收费应在考虑实际成本后的合理范围内，具体资料范围、形式、时间与费用应向窗口确认。
corrections.reason: The original reduces disclosure to payment followed by automatic copies; it omits the disclosure decision and treats fees as universal. Fees may be charged within a reasonable cost-based range.

sections.title: 診療件数と治療成績を読み分ける

paragraphs.text: 医療情報ネット（ナビイ）では、診療科だけでなく対応する疾患・治療、診療時間や外国語などを条件に全国の医療機関を探せます。まず必要な診療に対応する候補を絞り、予約の要否などを各施設に確認する使い方が実用的です。検索に掲載されていることだけで治療効果の優劣を判断することはできません。
成績の比較では患者の重症度や集計条件も見ます。国立がん研究センターの施設別生存率の説明では、進行がんの割合、追跡率、手術症例か全症例かによって数値が変わります。これはがん登録を用いた比較の注意点で、再生医療の有効性を示す証拠ではありません。数字の大小だけで病院を順位付けしない姿勢が必要です。

sections.title: 必要な支援と通院条件を比べる

paragraphs.text: 診療科名が同じでも提供できる支援は異なります。厚生労働省の精神科の案内では、専門分野、心理支援等のスタッフ、入院の可否や治療プログラムを確認するよう説明しています。この例のように、病院全体の規模ではなく、自分が必要とする診療と支援を具体的に問い合わせることが選択の手掛かりになります。
がんの病院選びでは、専門職の支援に加えて通院時間、交通費、体調不良時の移動や付き添いも判断材料です。口コミは患者の状態や目的が異なるため、それだけで決めず、必要ならがん相談支援センターに相談できます。この考え方を参考に、候補ごとに継続して通える条件を書き出して比較します。

sections.title: Distinguish activity from outcomes

paragraphs.text: Medical Information Net can search nationwide by specialty, conditions or treatments, opening hours and supported languages. Use it to identify candidates that offer the needed service, then confirm practical requirements such as appointments with each facility. A search listing describes services; it does not by itself establish superior treatment outcomes.

Outcome comparisons require attention to patient severity and the dataset. The National Cancer Center explains that cancer survival figures differ with stage distribution, follow-up completeness and whether surgical patients or all patients are included. These registry cautions concern cancer comparisons; they are not evidence for regenerative treatments or a basis for ranking hospitals by one number.

sections.title: Compare support and practical access

paragraphs.text: Identical specialty labels can conceal different services. For mental-health care, ministry guidance highlights clinical focus, psychological or social-support staff, inpatient capacity and treatment programmes. This illustrates why questions should concern the specific care and support required, rather than assuming that a hospital's overall size describes what an individual department can provide.

Cancer-care guidance includes specialist support, travel time and costs, transport when unwell and help from companions. Reviews may reflect different circumstances and should not decide the choice alone; cancer consultation centres can help. As a practical comparison, write down the conditions needed to keep attending each candidate hospital over time.

sections.title: 区分诊疗数量与治疗效果

paragraphs.text: 医疗信息网“ナビイ”可按科室、疾病与治疗项目、诊疗时间及外语服务等条件检索全国机构。可先筛选具备所需服务的候选机构，再逐一确认预约等实际要求。被检索系统收录只能说明服务信息，不能单凭这一点判断疗效优劣。
比较治疗结果时还应看患者严重程度及统计口径。国立癌症研究中心指出，晚期癌症患者比例、随访完整程度，以及纳入手术患者还是所有患者，都会影响生存率。这是癌症登记数据的比较注意事项，并非再生医疗有效性的证据，也不能仅凭数字高低给医院排名。

sections.title: 比较支持服务与就诊条件

paragraphs.text: 科室名称相同，能提供的服务也可能不同。厚生劳动省的精神科就医说明建议确认专长领域、心理或社会支持人员、能否住院及治疗项目。这个例子说明，选择时应具体询问所需诊疗和支持，不能用医院整体规模代替对具体科室能力的了解。
癌症医院选择指引除专业人员支持外，也重视往返时间、交通费用、不适时如何出行及陪同安排。评价者的病情和目的可能不同，不宜只凭口碑决定；需要时可咨询癌症咨询支援中心。比较候选医院时，可列出长期持续就诊所需的实际条件。

hospital-choice.auditNote: Examined all three versions; original advice on disease-specific experience, complications, communication and access was reasonable and did not require factual replacement. Added official search tools, cancer-registry case-mix limitations, a clearly scoped mental-health service example and cancer-care access guidance. The historical registry report is used only for interpretation cautions, not current hospital performance or evidence of regenerative-treatment efficacy. No clinician review or quality certification is claimed.

sections.title: 119番と相談窓口を使い分ける

paragraphs.text: 急に息が苦しくなる、意識がなく返事がない、顔の片側が動かしにくい、うまく話せないなどは救急車を呼ぶ目安です。胸の圧迫感が続く場合もあり、「激痛でなければ大丈夫」とは判断できません。こうした症状では予約や相談窓口の順番を待たず、119番につなぐことが公的な案内の基本です。
#7119は救急車を呼ぶか、今すぐ受診するか迷う場合に専門職へ相談する仕組みです。実施地域、対象年齢、利用時間は地域により異なり、全国で同じ条件ではありません。普段のうちに所在地の番号と時間を確認し、相談で緊急性が高いと判断された場合は119番への案内に従います。

sections.title: 通報・搬送時に引き継ぐ情報

paragraphs.text: 119番では救急であること、住所や目印、何が起きたか、年齢、連絡先を落ち着いて伝え、指令員の質問に答えます。救急隊には発症からの変化や行った応急手当も伝えます。お薬手帳、普段の薬、診察券、マイナ保険証または資格確認書をまとめておくと情報の引継ぎに役立ちます。
治験参加中は、交付された参加カードと担当窓口の連絡先を携帯します。熊本再春医療センターの案内では、他院受診時のカード提示や、他院で入院した事実の報告を求めています。併用薬が治験薬に影響する場合もあるため、参加情報を救急受診先と治験担当者の双方へ伝える準備が必要です。

sections.title: Distinguish 119 from telephone advice

paragraphs.text: Sudden breathing difficulty, unresponsiveness, one-sided facial weakness or difficulty speaking are reasons to call an ambulance. Persistent chest pressure also matters; absence of extreme pain does not establish safety. For these warning signs, official guidance supports calling 119 rather than waiting for an appointment or an advice-line response.

#7119 offers professional advice when someone is unsure whether an ambulance or immediate hospital visit is needed. Coverage, eligible ages and opening hours vary; it is not a uniform nationwide service. Check local arrangements in advance. If the adviser identifies high urgency, follow the instructions to connect or call back to 119.

sections.title: Prepare information for responders

paragraphs.text: On calling 119, say that an ambulance is needed and give the location or landmarks, what happened, the person's age and a contact number. Answer the dispatcher's questions. Tell responders about changes since onset and any first aid. Keep the medication record, usual medicines, clinic card and insurance-identification documents accessible.

During a clinical trial, carry any participant card issued and the team's contact details. Kumamoto Saishun Medical Center instructs participants to show the card at other hospitals and report an admission elsewhere. Other medicines can affect the investigational treatment, so prepare to share participation information with both the emergency provider and the trial team.

sections.title: 区分119急救与电话咨询

paragraphs.text: 突然呼吸困难、失去意识且无应答、单侧面部活动困难或说话不清，都是呼叫救护车的警示。持续胸部压迫感也需重视，不能因为没有剧痛就判断安全。出现这些表现时，官方建议直接拨打119，不要等待预约或咨询窗口接听。
#7119用于不确定是否需要救护车或立即就医时咨询专业人员。实施地区、适用年龄与服务时间各有不同，并非全国统一。平时应确认所在地的号码及开放时间；若咨询人员判断紧急程度高，应依照指示转接或拨打119。

sections.title: 准备通报和转送时的信息

paragraphs.text: 拨打119时，应说明需要急救，告知地址或地标、发生的情况、年龄及联系电话，并回答调度员提问。向急救人员说明发病后的变化和已实施的急救措施。平时集中放置用药手册、常用药、就诊卡及日本医保身份凭证，有助于交接信息。
参加药物临床试验时，应携带获发的参加卡和负责团队的联系方式。熊本再春医疗中心要求患者在外院就诊时出示卡片，并报告在其他医院住院的情况。其他药物可能影响试验治疗，因此应准备向急诊机构和试验团队双方说明参加情况。

corrections.old: 意識の変化、激しい胸痛や呼吸困難、まひなどは速やかに119番へ。迷うときは救急相談の窓口が利用できます。
corrections.new: 意識がない、急な呼吸困難、顔のゆがみや言葉の出にくさ、胸の圧迫感などの危険な症状では速やかに119番へ。相談窓口を先に通す必要はありません。緊急性の判断に迷う場合の#7119等は、地域・時間・対象年齢を確認して利用します。
corrections.reason: Clarifies that dangerous signs require direct 119 use and that telephone consultation availability is regional; severe pain is not the only cardiac warning pattern.

corrections.old: For consciousness changes, severe chest pain, breathing difficulty, or paralysis, call 119 promptly. When unsure, emergency consultation lines help.
corrections.new: Call 119 promptly for unresponsiveness, sudden breathing difficulty, facial weakness, speech difficulty or concerning chest pressure. An advice-line call is not a prerequisite. When urgency is uncertain, use #7119 or local advice services according to their area, hours and age eligibility.
corrections.reason: Clarifies that dangerous signs require direct 119 use and that telephone consultation availability is regional; severe pain is not the only cardiac warning pattern.

corrections.old: 意识变化、剧烈胸痛呼吸困难与麻痹等迅速打119。犹豫时可利用急救咨询窗口。
corrections.new: 出现无意识、突然呼吸困难、面部歪斜、言语困难或胸部压迫感等危险表现时，迅速拨打119，不必先经过咨询窗口。不确定紧急程度时，可按当地服务区域、开放时间及适用年龄使用#7119等咨询服务。
corrections.reason: Clarifies that dangerous signs require direct 119 use and that telephone consultation availability is regional; severe pain is not the only cardiac warning pattern.

corrections.old: 治験や細胞治療の参加中は研究チームの緊急連絡先を確認します。救急受診時は参加中であることを伝えましょう。
corrections.new: 治験中は担当チームの連絡先と参加カードを確認し、他院での受診・入院を伝えます。細胞治療では実施施設の連絡先を確認します。生命に関わる症状では担当者からの返答を待たず119番へ連絡し、救急隊に治療内容を伝えてください。
corrections.reason: The original conflates all cell therapy with research participation and could leave the priority between the research team and emergency services unclear.

corrections.old: During trial or cell therapy participation, confirm research teams' emergency contacts. Tell emergency visits about participation.
corrections.new: During a trial, keep the team's contact details and participant card, and report care or admission elsewhere. For cell therapy, confirm the treating facility's contact. For life-threatening symptoms, call 119 without waiting for that team's reply and tell responders about the treatment.
corrections.reason: The original conflates all cell therapy with research participation and could leave the priority between the research team and emergency services unclear.

corrections.old: 临床试验与细胞治疗参加中确认研究团队紧急联系方式。急诊时告知参加中。
corrections.new: 参加临床试验时，确认团队联系方式和参加卡，并报告外院就诊或住院。接受细胞治疗者应确认实施机构的联系方式。出现危及生命的症状时，不要等待团队回复，应拨打119，并向急救人员说明治疗内容。
corrections.reason: The original conflates all cell therapy with research participation and could leave the priority between the research team and emergency services unclear.

emergency-care.auditNote: Checked all original language versions against current FDMA #7119 area/hours information, the December 2025 ambulance manual, municipal red-flag guidance and an official NHO trial-participant page. Replaced the emergency/trial paragraphs in all languages to clarify direct 119 priority, regional advice-line limits and the distinction between trial participation and cell therapy. Did not infer nationwide 24-hour access or guarantee transfer to the usual hospital; content is public preparedness guidance, not individual triage.

sections.title: 薬局で伝える情報と継続確認

paragraphs.text: かかりつけ薬剤師には、他院の処方も含めた服薬状況や、飲み忘れ、余っている薬を伝えます。複数のお薬手帳は情報をまとめ、医師への照会や処方提案につなげてもらいます。薬を受け取った時だけでなく、その後の体調や飲めているかを共有することが、重複や副作用の確認に役立ちます。
電子版お薬手帳には服薬歴に加え、血圧などの健康情報や薬剤師との連絡機能を備えるものがあります。マイナポータルの記録を呼び出せるのは対応アプリで、本人の承諾が必要です。すべてのアプリが同じ機能を持つわけではないため、利用する薬局で確認し、診察時に提示できる状態にしておきます。

sections.title: 電子手帳とサプリメントの注意点

paragraphs.text: サプリメントは商品名だけでなく、成分と含有量が分かる表示、摂取量、開始日を示して相談します。消費者庁は自己判断で医薬品と併用しないよう案内し、複数の錠剤・カプセル製品の利用にも注意を促しています。高価な商品や体験談だけでは有効性を判断できず、薬の代わりの効果を期待して使うことも避けます。
健康食品の摂取後に体調の異変がある場合、厚生労働省の利用案内は速やかに摂取を中止して医師へ相談するよう案内しています。副作用らしい症状があっても相談まで飲み続ける、という意味の「自己判断で中止しない」は適切ではありません。表示の連絡先も確認し、製品名と摂取状況を医療者へ伝えます。

sections.title: Share medication information over time

paragraphs.text: Tell the regular pharmacist about prescriptions from other providers, missed doses and leftover medicines. Consolidating multiple medication records helps the pharmacist review the regimen and contact prescribers where needed. Review continues after dispensing: sharing changes in health and actual medicine use helps identify duplication, interactions and possible adverse effects.

Digital medication-record apps may include health measurements and communication with pharmacists as well as medicine histories. Importing records from Myna Portal requires a compatible app and the person's permission. Features vary, so check the app with the pharmacy and ensure the information can actually be displayed at consultations.

sections.title: Digital records and supplement safety

paragraphs.text: For supplements, bring ingredient and quantity labels, the amount taken and the start date, not just a brand name. The Consumer Affairs Agency advises against independently combining health foods with medicines or multiple tablet/capsule products. Price and testimonials do not establish effectiveness, and supplements should not be used in expectation of medicinal effects.

If health-food use is followed by feeling unwell, the ministry’s health-food booklet advises stopping intake promptly and consulting a doctor. A blanket instruction not to stop independently can wrongly encourage continued exposure while waiting for advice. Check the product contact details and tell the clinician what was taken and how it was used.

sections.title: 持续共享用药信息

paragraphs.text: 应向固定药剂师说明其他医院的处方、漏服及剩余药物。把多本用药手册的信息汇总，有助于药剂师检查整体用药，并在需要时询问处方医生或提出调整建议。取药后也应继续反馈身体变化和实际服药情况，帮助发现重复用药、相互作用及疑似副作用。
电子用药手册除用药史外，也可能提供血压等健康数据记录及药剂师沟通功能。从Myna Portal读取记录需要兼容应用，并取得本人同意。不同应用功能并不相同，应向使用的药房确认，并确保就诊时能够实际出示相关信息。

sections.title: 电子手册与保健品安全

paragraphs.text: 咨询保健品时，除商品名称，还应提供成分及含量标签、摄入量和开始日期。消费者厅提醒不要自行与药物合用，也应避免同时使用多种片剂或胶囊保健品。高价和使用者体验不能证明有效性，不应期待其发挥药品作用。
摄入保健食品后出现身体异常时，厚生劳动省的使用说明建议立即停止摄入并咨询医生。笼统要求“不要自行停用”可能误导人们在等待咨询期间继续摄入。应核对包装上的联系方式，并向医务人员说明具体产品及摄入情况。

corrections.old: サプリメントも薬に影響することがあります。使用中は医療者へ申告し、自己判断の中止や開始は避けましょう。
corrections.new: サプリメントと薬の併用は事前に医師・薬剤師へ相談し、商品や成分を伝えます。健康食品の摂取後に体調の異変を感じたら、速やかに摂取を中止して医師に相談してください。
corrections.reason: The blanket prohibition on stopping supplements conflicts with official advice to stop intake promptly if adverse symptoms develop; supplement decisions must not be conflated with routine prescription changes.

corrections.old: Supplements can affect medicines. Always declare use and avoid starting or stopping by self-judgment.
corrections.new: Consult a doctor or pharmacist before combining supplements with medicines and identify the product and ingredients. If you feel unwell after taking a health-food product, stop taking it promptly and consult a doctor.
corrections.reason: The blanket prohibition on stopping supplements conflicts with official advice to stop intake promptly if adverse symptoms develop; supplement decisions must not be conflated with routine prescription changes.

corrections.old: 保健品也会影响药物。使用中务必申报，避免自行开始停止。
corrections.new: 保健品与药物合用前，应咨询医生或药剂师并说明产品与成分。摄入保健食品后若出现身体异常，应立即停止摄入并咨询医生。
corrections.reason: The blanket prohibition on stopping supplements conflicts with official advice to stop intake promptly if adverse symptoms develop; supplement decisions must not be conflated with routine prescription changes.

pharmacy-use.auditNote: Reviewed all three language versions using current official municipal pharmacy guidance, MHLW digital-record guidance and Consumer Affairs Agency supplement guidance/safety notice. Corrected the unsafe blanket instruction against stopping supplements in every language. The red-yeast-rice page is cited specifically for its general functional-food safety section, not to claim all supplements share that product's harms. No interaction-free or automatic complete-record guarantee is made. The older MHLW booklet is used only for symptom monitoring and stopping advice, corroborated by current CAA guidance; its historical food-regulation categories are not reproduced.

sections.title: 支援者の役割と利用開始

paragraphs.text: 訪問看護は健康状態の確認や医療処置、療養生活の支援を担い、訪問リハビリは生活動作や介助方法を検討します。薬の飲み合わせや残薬は薬剤師の担当領域です。同じ「訪問」でも役割は異なるため、困りごとごとに相談先を整理すると、誰に何を伝えるかが明確になります。すべての支援を一人の職種が担うわけではありません。
介護保険サービスは、自治体への申請、認定調査や主治医意見書による判定を経て、必要なケアプランと事業者との契約につなげます。要介護の人は居宅介護支援事業所、要支援の人は地域包括支援センターや指定を受けた介護予防支援事業者が相談先です。治療を受けた事実だけで介護サービスの利用資格や内容が決まるわけではありません。

sections.title: 同意を踏まえた情報共有

paragraphs.text: ケアプランに訪問看護などの医療サービスを位置付けるには、主治医等の指示が必要です。また、サービス担当者会議等で本人や家族の個人情報を使う場合は、それぞれの事前の文書同意が求められます。共有内容は治療後の注意事項や生活上の変化など支援に必要な事項として整理し、計画と実際の支援が合っているかを担当者と確認します。

sections.title: Professional roles and starting services

paragraphs.text: Visiting nurses monitor health, provide medical procedures and support daily care. Rehabilitation staff address daily activities and ways to assist the person, while pharmacists review interactions and leftover medicines. These visiting services have different roles. A list linking each concern to the relevant professional can clarify whom to contact; one professional does not provide every kind of support.

Long-term care insurance services involve a municipal application and assessment, including medical information, followed by an appropriate plan and provider contracts. People certified as needing care consult a care-management provider; those needing support can consult a community comprehensive support center or designated preventive-care support provider. Receiving medical treatment alone does not determine eligibility or the services available.

sections.title: Sharing information with consent

paragraphs.text: Including visiting nursing and other medical services in a care plan requires the relevant physician’s instructions. Using a person’s or family member’s personal information in service coordination meetings requires that individual’s prior written consent. Organize information needed for support, such as post-treatment precautions and changes in daily functioning, and check with the team that the plan matches the care actually provided.

sections.title: 人员分工与服务启动

paragraphs.text: 上门护士负责健康观察、医疗处置及疗养生活支持；康复人员评估日常动作和协助方法；药物相互作用与余药则可向药师咨询。同样是上门服务，各专业的职责并不相同。可将具体困难与相应联系人逐项对应，明确什么情况应向谁反映，而不是把所有支持工作都交给一个专业人员。
使用日本介护保险服务，通常先向自治体申请，再结合认定调查及主治医生意见书评定，之后制定计划并与服务机构签约。获认定为“要介护”者可咨询居宅介护支援机构；“要支援”者可咨询地区综合支援中心或获指定的介护预防支援机构。仅仅接受过治疗，并不能决定介护服务资格或可使用的项目。

sections.title: 在同意基础上共享信息

paragraphs.text: 照护计划如需纳入上门护理等医疗服务，必须有相关主治医生的指示。在服务协调会议等场合使用本人或家属的个人信息时，应事先取得相应人员的书面同意。共享内容可整理为支持所必需的治疗后注意事项、日常功能变化等，并与各担当人员核对计划是否与实际提供的支持相符。

corrections.old: 治療内容や注意事項を支援者と共有し、変化があれば早めに連絡します。連絡帳や記録が役立ちます。
corrections.new: 治療内容や注意事項は、本人の意向と情報共有の同意範囲を確認して支援者に伝えます。サービス担当者会議等で本人・家族の個人情報を用いる場合は、それぞれの事前の文書同意が必要です。変化の連絡先を決め、連絡帳等に必要な情報を記録します。
corrections.reason: Unqualified sharing advice omitted the consent requirements for personal information used in formal care coordination.

corrections.old: Share treatment contents and cautions with supporters and contact early with changes. Contact books and records help.
corrections.new: Share treatment details and precautions within the person’s wishes and agreed scope. Using a patient’s or family member’s personal information in service coordination meetings requires that person’s prior written consent. Agree whom to contact about changes and record the information needed for care.
corrections.reason: Unqualified sharing advice omitted the consent requirements for personal information used in formal care coordination.

corrections.old: 与支援者分享治疗内容与注意，有变化早联系。联络本与记录有用。
corrections.new: 向支援人员传达治疗内容和注意事项前，应确认本人的意愿及同意共享的范围。服务协调会议等使用本人或家属的个人信息时，须事先取得相应人员的书面同意。事先确定变化发生时的联系人，并记录照护所需的信息。
corrections.reason: Unqualified sharing advice omitted the consent requirements for personal information used in formal care coordination.

nursing-care-link.auditNote: Compared all three locale bodies and points with municipal guidance and national care-management standards. Added role distinctions, certification pathways and consent requirements. The original coordination advice was broadly sound; the information-sharing paragraph needed an explicit consent boundary. This is a service-system audit, not evidence of a regenerative treatment benefit or an assessment of any individual provider.

sources.title: 救急車を上手に使いましょう ～救急車 必要なのはどんなとき?～
sources.studyType: Fire and Disaster Management Agency public emergency guidance; December 2025 edition

sections.title: 在宅医療を始めるときの確認

paragraphs.text: 訪問診療は通院が困難な人の医療を生活の場で支える仕組みです。入院中なら主治医や看護師、医療ソーシャルワーカー、通院中ならかかりつけ医などが相談先になります。介護保険を利用している場合はケアマネジャーも調整に関わります。必要な処置、薬の管理、生活動作の支援を分けて整理し、どの訪問職種に依頼するか検討します。
定期的な訪問診療では継続する病状を管理し、往診では発熱など予定外の変化に応じて臨時に診察します。在宅での療養は医療と介護を組み合わせるため、開始前に夜間の連絡先、往診を依頼する手順、家族が担うことを具体化するのが実用的です。家族の負担が増した場合は、短期入所や療養場所の変更も含めて支援の組合せを見直します。

sections.title: 予定外の変化と救急対応

paragraphs.text: 重い急変では、在宅の連絡体制だけで対応しようとせず救急要請を判断する必要があります。消防庁は重大な病気やけがが疑われる症状では救急車をためらわず呼ぶよう案内しています。119番では住所、症状、意識や呼吸の状態を伝えます。持病、普段の薬、医師の指示をまとめておくと救急隊への引継ぎに役立ちます。

sections.title: Arranging home medical care

paragraphs.text: Home medical visits support people who have difficulty attending a clinic. During hospitalization, the doctor, nurse or medical social worker can help arrange care; outpatients can begin with their usual doctor. A care manager can coordinate when long-term care insurance services are involved. List medical procedures, medication management and assistance with daily activities separately to identify the visiting professionals needed.

Scheduled visits manage continuing medical needs, while house calls address unplanned changes such as fever. Because home care combines medical and everyday support, a practical preparation is to identify the nighttime contact, the procedure for requesting a house call and the family’s responsibilities. If caregiving demands increase, review the combination of services, including short stays or a different care setting.

sections.title: Unplanned changes and emergencies

paragraphs.text: Severe deterioration requires consideration of emergency services rather than relying solely on the home-care contact system. The Fire and Disaster Management Agency advises calling an ambulance without hesitation for symptoms suggesting serious illness or injury. When calling 119, give the address, symptoms and state of consciousness and breathing. A record of conditions, medicines and medical instructions helps the ambulance team take over care.

sections.title: 开始居家医疗前的确认

paragraphs.text: 居家诊疗主要支持难以前往医疗机构的人。住院期间可向主治医生、护士或医疗社会工作者咨询；门诊患者可先与平时就诊的医生商量。已使用介护保险服务时，照护经理也可参与协调。可分别列出所需医疗处置、用药管理及日常动作协助，讨论需要哪些专业人员提供上门服务。
定期上门诊疗用于持续管理病情，临时出诊则应对发热等计划外变化。居家疗养需要医疗和生活照护配合，开始前可明确夜间联系人、申请临时出诊的步骤及家属承担的任务。若家庭照护负担增加，应重新讨论服务组合，包括短期入住机构或调整疗养地点，不能只依靠家属继续承担。

sections.title: 临时变化与急救应对

paragraphs.text: 病情严重突变时，需要判断是否呼叫急救，不能仅依赖居家服务的联系机制。日本消防厅建议，出现提示严重疾病或伤害的症状时应毫不犹豫地呼叫救护车。拨打119时说明地址、症状、意识及呼吸状态。预先整理基础疾病、日常用药及医生指示，有助于向急救人员交接。

corrections.old: 訪問診療は定期的な計画訪問、往診は急変時の臨時訪問です。両者を組み合わせた体制を確認しましょう。
corrections.new: 訪問診療は、通院が困難な人への定期的・計画的な診療です。往診は発熱などの変化に応じた臨時の診療ですが、重い急変で救急対応が必要な場合は119番を利用します。往診と救急搬送は同じものではなく、事前に連絡手順を確認します。
corrections.reason: Original definition could direct all sudden deterioration toward house calls; English also incorrectly used the broad term home care as a synonym for scheduled physician visits.

corrections.old: Home care means regular planned visits; house calls mean ad hoc visits for sudden changes. Confirm combined systems.
corrections.new: Scheduled home medical visits provide planned ongoing care for people who cannot readily attend a clinic. House calls are unplanned visits for changes such as fever. Severe deterioration may require an ambulance through 119; a house call is not an emergency transport service. Confirm contact procedures beforehand.
corrections.reason: Original definition could direct all sudden deterioration toward house calls; English also incorrectly used the broad term home care as a synonym for scheduled physician visits.

corrections.old: 访问诊疗指定期计划访问，往诊指急变时临时访问。确认两者组合的体制。
corrections.new: 定期上门诊疗是为难以前往医疗机构的人提供有计划的持续诊疗；临时出诊则应对发热等变化。严重突变需要急救时应拨打119，临时出诊与急救转运不是同一种服务。应事先确认联系流程。
corrections.reason: Original definition could direct all sudden deterioration toward house calls; English also incorrectly used the broad term home care as a synonym for scheduled physician visits.

home-care.auditNote: Reviewed all locale text against official municipal home-care descriptions and the FDMA December 2025 emergency manual. Corrected wording that could equate all acute deterioration with a house call, and the English conflation of home care with scheduled doctor visits. Katsushika is used only for stable service definitions and care-setting options, not its historical fees. Availability and response times were not verified for any provider.

sources.studyType: Japan Health Insurance Association official eligibility and payment guidance

sections.title: 両立支援と所得保障を分ける

paragraphs.text: 2026年4月1日から、治療と就業の両立支援は事業主の努力義務になりました。ただし、希望する有給の病気休暇や短時間勤務が一律に保障されるという意味ではありません。制度の有無、対象者、休業中の賃金や復職手順は就業規則で確認します。本人の相談を起点に、治療を続けながら可能な業務や勤務時間を職場と検討する仕組みです。
協会けんぽの傷病手当金は、業務外の病気やけがで働けず、連続3日の待期後も休み、十分な給与がないなどの条件があります。支給期間は支給開始日から通算1年6か月で、給与が一部出る場合は調整されます。自費の診療でも労務不能の証明があれば対象となり得ますが、治療の予約や通院だけで受給できる制度ではありません。

sections.title: 仕事内容に即した調整

paragraphs.text: 主治医には勤務時間だけでなく、運転や夜勤など実際の業務情報を伝え、必要な配慮について意見を求めます。健康情報は本人の同意を踏まえて支援に必要な範囲で共有し、上司や同僚にすべての診療情報を伝える前提にはしません。配慮の内容と見直し時期を計画にし、症状や治療が変わったときは仕事内容との適合を再確認します。

sections.title: Separate workplace support from income benefits

paragraphs.text: Since April 1, 2026, employers have had a duty to endeavor to support treatment alongside employment. This does not automatically guarantee a requested paid sickness leave arrangement or reduced hours. Check workplace rules for eligibility, pay during absence and return-to-work procedures. The process starts with the worker’s request and considers duties and hours compatible with continued treatment.

Under Kyokai Kenpo, sickness allowance requires inability to work because of a non-work-related illness or injury, absence beyond a three-consecutive-day waiting period and insufficient wages, among other conditions. Payment is limited to a cumulative year and six months from its start and may be adjusted for wages. Self-funded treatment can qualify with evidence of incapacity; appointments alone do not establish eligibility.

sections.title: Adjustments based on actual job duties

paragraphs.text: Give the treating doctor actual job information, including driving or night work, when requesting advice about adjustments. Share health information for support with the worker’s consent and within the necessary scope; supervisors and colleagues need not receive the entire medical history. Record the agreed measures and review date, and reconsider their suitability when treatment or symptoms change.

sections.title: 区分工作支持与收入保障

paragraphs.text: 自2026年4月1日起，日本雇主负有努力支持治疗与就业兼顾的义务，但这不等于所申请的带薪病假或短时工作会一律获得保障。应查看就业规则中的适用人员、休业期间工资及复职程序。通常由本人提出咨询，再与单位讨论可在持续治疗期间承担的工作和工作时间。
协会健保的伤病津贴要求因非工作原因的疾病或受伤而无法工作，连续等待3天后仍休业，且工资不足等。支给期间自开始支给起累计最长1年6个月；部分领取工资时会调整金额。自费诊疗在有不能工作的证明等情况下也可能符合条件，但仅预约治疗或定期就诊并不能取得领取资格。

sections.title: 根据实际工作安排调整

paragraphs.text: 向主治医生说明工作情况时，除工时外，还应包括驾驶、夜班等实际任务，以便医生提出工作调整意见。健康信息应在本人同意的基础上，按支持所需范围共享，不应默认上司和同事需要知道全部诊疗资料。将调整措施及复查时间写入计划，症状或治疗变化时再核对是否适合现有工作。

corrections.old: 傷病手当金、休職制度、時短勤務、両立支援コーディネーターなどがあります。就業規則と合わせて確認しましょう。
corrections.new: 傷病手当金は加入保険や労務不能、待期、給与などの条件を満たす場合の給付です。病気休暇・休職・短時間勤務の有無や待遇は勤務先の規則で異なります。両立支援の相談窓口も確認し、利用できる制度を個別に整理します。
corrections.reason: The original list conflated conditional statutory insurance benefits, employer-specific arrangements and advisory support without explaining their different eligibility.

corrections.old: Injury and sickness allowances, leave systems, reduced hours, and balance-support coordinators exist. Check with work rules too.
corrections.new: Sickness allowance depends on insurance coverage, inability to work, waiting-period and wage conditions. Availability and terms of sickness leave, extended leave and reduced hours vary by workplace rules. Check the support contact and establish which arrangements and benefits apply to your circumstances.
corrections.reason: The original list conflated conditional statutory insurance benefits, employer-specific arrangements and advisory support without explaining their different eligibility.

corrections.old: 有伤病津贴、休职制度、短时工作与两立支援协调员等。结合就业规则确认。
corrections.new: 伤病津贴取决于加入的保险、不能工作、等待期及工资等条件。病假、休职及短时工作是否可用、期间待遇如何，因单位规定而异。应确认兼顾治疗与工作的咨询窗口，并逐项核实可使用的制度。
corrections.reason: The original list conflated conditional statutory insurance benefits, employer-specific arrangements and advisory support without explaining their different eligibility.

corrections.old: 通院の頻度や体調の波を職場と共有し、代替体制を決めておきます。無理のないペースが長続きの秘訣です。
corrections.new: 通院予定や業務上必要な配慮は、本人が同意した必要な範囲で職場の担当者と共有します。健康情報を誰が扱うかを確認し、業務の代替方法と計画の見直し時期を決めます。
corrections.reason: Broadly instructing disclosure to the workplace omitted consent, purpose limitation and designated handling of sensitive health information.

corrections.old: Share visit frequency and condition waves with workplaces and fix backup systems. Sustainable paces last longest.
corrections.new: Share appointment needs and relevant work adjustments with the designated workplace contact within the necessary scope agreed by the worker. Clarify who handles health information, how duties will be covered and when the plan will be reviewed.
corrections.reason: Broadly instructing disclosure to the workplace omitted consent, purpose limitation and designated handling of sensitive health information.

corrections.old: 与职场分享就诊频率与身体波动，定好替代体制。不勉强的节奏最长久。
corrections.new: 就诊安排及必要的工作调整，应在本人同意的必要范围内与单位指定人员共享。明确谁负责处理健康信息、如何安排工作替补，以及何时重新评估计划。
corrections.reason: Broadly instructing disclosure to the workplace omitted consent, purpose limitation and designated handling of sensitive health information.

work-balance.auditNote: Audited Japanese, English and Chinese against the effective 2026 support guideline and insurer benefit rules. Distinguished employer efforts from automatic entitlements, and wage replacement from medical-cost reimbursement. Corrected generalized availability and unbounded health-information sharing in all locales. No individual employment contract or insurer determination was assessed.

sources.studyType: MHLW official guidance on advanced medical care and insured versus self-paid components

sources.studyType: National Tax Agency guidance on eligible medical expenses and exclusions; law as of April 1, 2026

sections.title: 見積りを条件と支払区分に分解する

paragraphs.text: 再生医療の費用比較では、予定回数だけでなく、追加投与、途中中止、細胞の保管などで請求が変わる条件を質問項目にします。これは全施設に共通する料金表ではなく、書面で個別に確認するための整理方法です。説明時には費用、他の治療法の利益・不利益、健康被害時の補償も確認し、補償があることとすべての損失が支払われることを区別します。
「先進医療」という公的制度では、先進医療の技術料は全額自己負担で、通常の診療と共通する部分は保険給付の対象になります。高額療養費が適用されるのは保険給付に係る自己負担部分です。この取扱いを自由診療全般へ当てはめず、見積りには制度名と保険・自費の内訳を記載してもらい、どの部分に給付を見込めるか確認します。

sections.title: 家計負担と税の扱いを分ける

paragraphs.text: 予算表では治療費、移動・宿泊費、付き添いによる収入減などを別欄にし、同じ交通費を二重に数えないようにします。家計上の負担と医療費控除の対象は一致せず、自家用車のガソリン代や駐車料金は控除対象外です。控除は所得から差し引く仕組みで、費用の全額返金ではありません。補填金や税の効果が未確定なら、確定した値と仮定を分けて試算します。

sections.title: Break down assumptions and payment categories

paragraphs.text: For a regenerative treatment estimate, list questions about extra administrations, stopping treatment and cell storage that could change the bill. This is a way to obtain case-specific written clarification, not a universal price schedule. Review costs alongside alternative treatments and their benefits and disadvantages, and ask about injury compensation. The existence of compensation arrangements does not establish that every loss will be covered.

Under Japan’s official advanced-medical-care framework, the advanced procedure fee is paid in full by the patient, while common elements of ordinary care can receive insurance benefits. High-cost medical expense benefits apply to the insured copayment component. Do not extend this arrangement to all private treatment: request the scheme name and an insured/self-paid breakdown before estimating benefits.

sections.title: Separate household costs from tax treatment

paragraphs.text: Use separate budget columns for treatment, travel and lodging, and income lost by companions; count each trip once. Household burden and tax-deductible spending are different: fuel and parking for a private car are excluded from the medical expense deduction. The deduction reduces income for tax purposes and is not a full refund of treatment costs. Keep confirmed reimbursements and assumed tax effects separate in the estimate.

sections.title: 拆分报价条件与支付类别

paragraphs.text: 比较再生医疗报价时，除计划次数外，可将追加给药、中途停止、细胞保管等可能改变收费的条件列为询问项目。这是取得个别书面说明的方法，并非所有机构通用的价目表。还应一并了解替代治疗的利弊及健康损害补偿安排；存在补偿机制并不意味着所有损失都会得到赔付。
在日本正式的“先進医療”制度下，先进技术本身的费用由患者全额承担，普通诊疗的共同部分可获得保险给付；高额疗养费制度只适用于保险给付部分的自付费用。不能把这种安排套用于所有自由诊疗。报价应注明所用制度及保险、自费项目的明细，再核实哪些费用可以预计获得给付。

sections.title: 区分家庭负担和税务处理

paragraphs.text: 预算表可分别列出治疗、交通住宿及陪同者收入减少等栏目，同一次交通支出只计一次。家庭实际负担并不等同于医疗费扣除对象，例如私家车燃油和停车费不在扣除范围内。医疗费扣除是所得扣除，不是全额退还治疗费用。补偿金或税务效果尚未确定时，应将已确认数字与假设分开计算。

corrections.old: 診察、検査、加工、投与、薬、通院の各費用を書き出します。自由診療では総額を記した書面を受け取り、契約条件を確認しましょう。
corrections.new: 診察、検査、加工、投与、薬などの医療費を項目別に整理し、交通費は別欄で一度だけ計上します。自由診療では予定総額と含まれない費用、追加・中止時の扱いを書面で確認します。見積りの前提が変わる場合は、総額も再確認します。
corrections.reason: Travel appeared in both direct and indirect costs; translated wording also implied a fixed written total without assumptions or exclusions.

corrections.old: List visits, tests, processing, administration, drugs, and travel. For private care, always receive written totals.
corrections.new: List visits, tests, processing, administration and medicines, and count travel once in a separate column. For private treatment, request a written estimated total, exclusions and terms for additional treatment or stopping. Recheck the total if the assumptions change.
corrections.reason: Travel appeared in both direct and indirect costs; translated wording also implied a fixed written total without assumptions or exclusions.

corrections.old: 列出门诊、检查、加工、给药、药物与交通。自由诊疗务必拿到总额书面。
corrections.new: 逐项列出诊察、检查、加工、给药和药物费用，交通费另列并只计一次。自由诊疗应书面确认预计总额、不含项目、追加治疗及中止时的处理条件；报价前提变化时，需要重新核对总额。
corrections.reason: Travel appeared in both direct and indirect costs; translated wording also implied a fixed written total without assumptions or exclusions.

cost-simulation.auditNote: Reviewed estimates, insurance distinctions and tax implications against topic-specific official sources. Replaced the direct-cost paragraphs to remove the direct/indirect travel double-counting risk and distinguish estimates from guaranteed final totals. Added a practical budgeting method without asserting market prices, coverage of a particular treatment or an unconditional refund right.

sections.title: 診療月と所得区分を合わせて確認

paragraphs.text: 2026年9月22日時点では、同年8月の月額上限の見直しと年間上限の導入を踏まえて確認する必要があります。年間の集計期間は8月から翌年7月です。2027年8月の所得区分細分化などはまだ適用前なので、将来の表を現在の診療費に使わないようにします。年齢、加入保険、所得区分、診療月をそろえて該当する表を確認します。
例えば2026年8月～2027年7月の協会けんぽで、70歳未満・標準報酬月額28万～50万円の通常の月額上限は、85,800円＋（保険診療総額－286,000円）×1％です。総額100万円なら92,940円となります。この例は保険外費用を含まず、多数回該当などの別条件もあります。給与の手取り額から区分を決めず、保険者に確認します。

sections.title: 窓口負担と払い戻しは別に確認

paragraphs.text: オンライン資格確認に対応した医療機関では、マイナ保険証によって限度額情報を確認できる場合、通常は認定証の事前取得を省けます。ただし窓口での上限適用は医療機関ごと、入院・外来等の区分ごとの取扱いです。複数受診の合算は後日の申請が必要になる場合があり、保険外の差額ベッド代や入院時の食事負担等まで上限内になるわけではありません。

sections.title: Match the treatment month and income category

paragraphs.text: As of September 22, 2026, calculations must reflect the August 2026 monthly-limit revision and introduction of annual limits. The annual period runs from August through the following July. The finer income categories scheduled for August 2027 are not yet applicable. Match the treatment month, age, insurer and income category before choosing the relevant table.

For Kyokai Kenpo members under 70 with standard monthly remuneration of ¥280,000–500,000, the ordinary monthly limit for August 2026–July 2027 is ¥85,800 plus 1% of insured total charges above ¥286,000. Insured charges of ¥1 million give ¥92,940. This excludes uninsured costs and does not apply the separate repeated-use reduction. Confirm the category with the insurer rather than using take-home pay.

sections.title: Distinguish counter limits from reimbursement

paragraphs.text: At a provider using online eligibility verification, a My Number insurance card can usually avoid obtaining a separate certificate when limit information is available. Counter limits are applied by provider and separately for categories such as inpatient and outpatient care. Combining payments from several visits may require a later claim. Uninsured room supplements and inpatient meal contributions do not become covered by the limit.

sections.title: 核对诊疗月份与所得档次

paragraphs.text: 截至2026年9月22日，计算时应考虑同年8月已实施的月度上限调整及年度上限。年度统计期间为8月至次年7月。计划于2027年8月实施的所得档次细分等尚未适用，不能用将来的表格计算当前诊疗费用。应同时核对诊疗月份、年龄、加入的保险和所得档次。
例如，2026年8月至2027年7月，协会健保中未满70岁、标准报酬月额为28万至50万日元者，普通月度上限为85,800日元＋（保险诊疗总额－286,000日元）×1%。总额100万日元时为92,940日元。例子不含保险外费用，也未采用多次符合条件时的减额。不要按到手工资自行判断档次，应向保险方确认。

sections.title: 分别确认窗口限额与事后返还

paragraphs.text: 在支持在线资格确认的医疗机构，使用My Number保险证并能确认限额信息时，通常可省去事先领取认定证的步骤。但窗口限额按医疗机构及住院、门诊等类别分别处理；多处就诊费用合算可能需要事后申请。保险外的差额床位费、住院伙食负担等，并不会因此被纳入上限之内。

corrections.old: 事前に認定証を受けて提示すると、窓口での支払いが上限までになります。加入する保険者に申請します。
corrections.new: 限度額適用認定証を使うと、対象となる保険診療の窓口負担を抑えられますが、医療機関ごと・入院外来等の区分ごとの取扱いで、対象外費用は別です。対応施設でマイナ保険証により限度額情報を確認できれば通常は事前申請を省けます。複数受診の払い戻しや必要書類は保険者に確認します。
corrections.reason: Original paragraph promised that all counter payments would stop at a single limit and omitted exclusions, separate calculation units and the alternative digital eligibility route.

corrections.old: Receiving certificates in advance and showing them caps window payments at limits. Apply through your insurer.
corrections.new: A limit certificate can reduce eligible insured payments at the counter, but limits apply separately by provider and treatment category, and excluded charges remain payable. At supported facilities, using a My Number insurance card to confirm limit information usually avoids a prior certificate application. Ask the insurer about later reimbursement and required documents.
corrections.reason: Original paragraph promised that all counter payments would stop at a single limit and omitted exclusions, separate calculation units and the alternative digital eligibility route.

corrections.old: 事先拿到认定证出示，窗口支付封顶到上限。向加入的保险方申请。
corrections.new: 限额认定证可减少保险诊疗范围内的窗口支付，但按医疗机构及住院、门诊等类别分别处理，范围外费用仍须另外支付。在对应机构使用My Number保险证确认限额信息时，通常无须事先申请认定证。多处就诊后的返还及所需文件应向保险方确认。
corrections.reason: Original paragraph promised that all counter payments would stop at a single limit and omitted exclusions, separate calculation units and the alternative digital eligibility route.

Corrected the unconditional counter-payment cap in every locale and added the My Number route. Explicitly separated the effective August 2026 provisions from future August 2027 provisions; no individualized entitlement calculation performed.

sources.title: 医療費を支払ったとき
sources.studyType: National Tax Agency public tax guide covering deduction scope, documentation and compensation offsets

sections.title: 支払年と控除対象を切り分ける

paragraphs.text: 医療費控除は、その年の1月1日～12月31日に本人や生計を一にする親族のため実際に支払った対象費用で計算します。補填される保険金等を差し引き、原則10万円、総所得金額等が200万円未満ならその5％を超える部分が対象で、控除額は最高200万円です。これは所得控除であり、支払額や控除額がそのまま還付される制度ではありません。
自由診療か保険診療かだけでは対象を判定できません。医師等の診療・治療に対する費用でも、病状に応じた通常の支出水準を著しく超えない部分という条件があります。美容や健康増進など治療以外の目的の費用を一括して算入せず、治療内容と費用内訳を確認します。高額な再生医療だから自動的に対象になる、または対象外になるとはいえません。

sections.title: 交通費と申告資料の扱い

paragraphs.text: 通院に通常必要な電車・バス代は対象になり得ますが、タクシーは公共交通機関を利用できない場合などに限られ、自家用車の燃料費や駐車料金は対象外です。日付、受診先、経路、金額を記録し、申告には医療費控除の明細書を用います。領収書は原則として申告期限等から5年間保管し、医療費通知で記載を省略できる部分との重複計上を避けます。

sections.title: Separate payment year from expense eligibility

paragraphs.text: The deduction uses qualifying expenses actually paid from January 1 to December 31 for oneself or relatives sharing the same livelihood. After relevant insurance reimbursements, subtract ¥100,000, or 5% of total income as defined for tax purposes when that income is below ¥2 million. The deduction is capped at ¥2 million. It reduces income for tax purposes; neither the bill nor the deduction is automatically refunded in full.

Insurance status alone does not determine eligibility. Even payment for a doctor’s treatment is subject to the condition that the amount does not markedly exceed the usual level for the condition. Do not automatically include spending for appearance or health promotion: examine the purpose and itemized charges. A high price for regenerative treatment establishes neither eligibility nor ineligibility by itself.

sections.title: Travel and filing records

paragraphs.text: Ordinarily necessary train or bus fares for treatment may qualify; taxis are generally excluded unless public transport cannot be used. Private-car fuel and parking do not qualify. Record dates, providers, routes and fares, and prepare the medical expense statement for filing. Generally retain receipts for five years from the filing deadline and avoid counting costs twice when also using an insurer’s medical expense notification.

sections.title: 区分支付年度与可扣除费用

paragraphs.text: 医疗费扣除按1月1日至12月31日期间，为本人或共同维持生计的亲属实际支付的合格费用计算。扣除相应保险补偿等后，通常减去10万日元；税法规定的总所得金额等不足200万日元时，减去其5%。扣除额最高200万日元。这是所得扣除，不是将账单金额或扣除额全额退还。
不能仅凭保险诊疗或自由诊疗来判断是否可扣除。即使支付给医生用于诊疗，也有金额不得明显超过相应病情通常支出水平的条件。不要把美容、促进健康等非治疗目的的费用一并计入，应核对治疗目的及费用明细。再生医疗价格高，并不意味着自动符合或不符合扣除条件。

sections.title: 交通费与申报资料

paragraphs.text: 通常必要的就医电车或公交费用可能符合条件；出租车一般不符合，除非不能使用公共交通等情况。私家车燃油和停车费不符合。应记录日期、就诊机构、路线与金额，并制作医疗费扣除明细书。收据原则上自申报期限等起保管5年，使用保险方的医疗费通知简化填写时，应避免同一费用重复计入。

corrections.old: When yearly medical spending exceeds set amounts, income deductions apply. Treatment-purpose private care can also qualify.
corrections.new: Medical expenses that meet the legal conditions, including qualifying payments for diagnosis or treatment by a physician, may support an income deduction under the prescribed calculation. Private treatment is neither universally eligible nor universally excluded: check its purpose, the nature and usual level of the costs, and current National Tax Agency guidance or the tax office.
corrections.reason: Translations omitted the Japanese overview’s statutory qualification and could imply that annual spending and treatment purpose alone establish deductibility; NTA also restricts amounts markedly above usual costs.

corrections.old: 一年医疗费超一定额可享所得扣除。以治疗为目的的自由诊疗也可能对象。
corrections.new: 符合日本法定条件的医疗费用，例如符合要求的医生诊疗费用，可按规定计算所得扣除。自由诊疗并非一律符合或一律不符合条件；应核对治疗目的、费用性质及是否明显超过通常支出水平，并查阅国税厅最新指南或向税务署确认。
corrections.reason: Translations omitted the Japanese overview’s statutory qualification and could imply that annual spending and treatment purpose alone establish deductibility; NTA also restricts amounts markedly above usual costs.

tax-deduction.auditNote: Compared the Japanese qualification already present with the less qualified English and Chinese originals. Inspected NTA guidance marked current as of April 1, 2026 plus the public filing guide. Corrected the translated overview to retain statutory expense and usual-cost conditions; the Japanese overview did not require replacement. Added calculation, actual-payment timing, travel exclusions and records. No ruling on deductibility of any named regenerative intervention is claimed.

sources.studyType: 金融庁の保険契約・告知・保険金支払に関する相談事例と行政上の説明

sections.title: 公的保障を家計に当てはめる

paragraphs.text: 高額療養費の上限は一律ではなく、年齢・所得や診療を受けた時期によって確認が必要です。長期療養では多数回該当などの仕組みもあります。古い上限額を家計表に固定せず、加入先の保険者に適用区分を確認し、将来の見直し予定と現在の扱いを分けて見積もります。
高額療養費は保険診療の自己負担が対象で、希望して利用する差額ベッド代、食費、先進医療の技術料などまで一括して上限内になる制度ではありません。必要額の表では保険診療分と対象外費用を分け、病院の見積書のどの項目を自己資金で支払うか確認すると、不足分が見えやすくなります。

sections.title: 契約で確認する不足分

paragraphs.text: 収入減への備えは治療費と別に確認します。協会けんぽの傷病手当金は、業務外の病気などで働けず、給与が十分に支払われない被保険者が対象で、連続３日の待期後の４日目以降が支給対象です。支給期間は通算１年６か月で、すべての保険加入者に同じ所得保障があるとは見積もれません。
民間保険は、給付対象となる入院・手術などの定義や特別条件を約款で確認します。健康状態は保険会社が質問した事項に正確に回答する仕組みです。持病を告知して加入できても、除外条件や割増保険料が付くことがあります。「加入できること」と「希望する治療に給付されること」は別に確認します。

sections.title: Apply public benefits to the household budget

paragraphs.text: High-cost medical expense limits depend on age, income and the treatment period. Repeated qualifying months can bring additional relief. Use the applicable category confirmed by the health insurer when budgeting; distinguish current rules from announced future changes instead of carrying forward an old ceiling.

The ceiling applies to eligible insured care, not every hospital expense. Meals, an optional upgraded room and advanced-treatment technical fees are excluded. Separate insured copayments from excluded charges in the hospital estimate so that the amount requiring savings or contract-specific private benefits is visible.

sections.title: Check the actual insurance contract

paragraphs.text: Income replacement is separate from medical-cost protection. Under Kyokai Kenpo, eligible insured employees unable to work because of non-work-related illness or injury, without sufficient wages, may receive sickness allowance from day four after three consecutive waiting days, for up to 18 months in total. Do not assume every insurance member has this benefit.

Check the contract definitions of covered admissions and procedures, plus special conditions. Disclosure means answering the insurer’s questions accurately. Acceptance after disclosing a condition may still involve exclusions or higher premiums. Being accepted for insurance and having a particular treatment covered are separate questions.

sections.title: 把公共保障纳入家庭预算

paragraphs.text: 高额疗养费限额并非人人相同，需要按年龄、收入及就诊时期确认。长期治疗还可能适用多次达到限额后的减负机制。编制预算时，应向参保机构确认适用类别，区分现行规定与未来调整计划，不要一直沿用旧限额。
限额针对符合条件的医保诊疗个人负担，并不涵盖全部住院支出。伙食费、自愿选择的差额病床费、先进医疗技术费等不在其中。应把医院估价中的医保部分与不适用部分分开，才能看清哪些费用需要存款或保单约定的给付来承担。

sections.title: 核对保单实际保障

paragraphs.text: 收入减少的保障应与医疗费保障分别核对。协会健保的伤病津贴适用于因非工作原因患病或受伤而无法工作、且工资不足的被保险人；连续等待三天后，从第四天起符合条件的日期可获给付，累计最长一年六个月。不能假定所有参保人都有相同的收入保障。
商业保险应核对住院、手术等给付条件及特别约定。健康告知要求如实回答保险公司提出的问题。即使告知既往病史后获准投保，也可能附带除外责任或加收保费。能否投保与某项治疗能否获赔，必须分别确认。

insurance-review.auditNote: Reviewed all supplied Japanese, English and Chinese paragraphs against current MHLW, Kyokai Kenpo and FSA guidance. Original general budgeting advice was not materially false; additions clarify eligibility, excluded expenses and contract limits. The historical MHLW PDF is used only for excluded categories, not its old monetary tables. No universal premium, payout, or future reform is presented as a current entitlement; no individual contract was assessed.

sources.studyType: 2021 expert literature review and risk-communication recommendations; not a treatment trial

sources.studyType: 2021 systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized evaluations of explicit values-clarification methods

sections.title: 比較表の効果と数字の読み方

paragraphs.text: 2024年のコクランレビューは、治療や検診を選ぶ成人を対象とする209件の無作為化試験、計107,698人を検討しました。意思決定支援ツールは通常の説明より知識やリスク理解を改善しましたが、決定後の後悔には差がありませんでした。選び方を助ける根拠であり、選んだ治療の治癒率を高める証明ではありません。決定の質に関する評価と、治療成績そのものの評価は分けて読みます。
比較する確率は、同じ人数・期間・結果の定義にそろえます。例えば「100人が５年間で経験する人数」という共通の形式なら、選択肢間の差を読み取りやすくなります。対象者の条件や推定の不確かさも確認し、分母の違う数字や「まれ」「高い」だけの表現で優劣を決めないことが大切です。数字の意味が分からない箇所は診察で質問します。

sections.title: 価値観を対話につなげる

paragraphs.text: 価値観の整理は点数化に限られず、利益と負担を書き出す方法や、何を優先するかを話し合う方法もあります。43種類の方法を扱う試験のレビューでは、明示的な整理に一定の利点がありましたが、研究間のばらつきもありました。点数だけで答えを出すより、迷う理由や譲れない条件を説明する材料として使います。

sections.title: What comparison aids achieve and how to read numbers

paragraphs.text: A 2024 Cochrane review included 209 randomized trials with 107,698 adults facing treatment or screening decisions. Aids improved knowledge and risk understanding compared with usual care, but did not change decision regret. This supports better decision processes; it does not establish that using a table improves the chosen treatment’s cure rate. Distinguish measures of decision quality from clinical treatment outcomes.

Compare probabilities using the same denominator, time period and outcome definition—for example, people affected out of 100 over five years. Check the population and uncertainty behind each estimate. Mixing denominators or relying only on labels such as “rare” can distort the apparent difference between options. Bring unclear figures to the consultation.

sections.title: Turn priorities into a discussion

paragraphs.text: Values clarification can use written trade-offs or a structured conversation as well as scores. A review covering trials of 43 methods found benefits from explicit clarification, with heterogeneity across studies. Use the exercise to explain uncertainties and priorities; a numerical total need not dictate the final choice.

sections.title: 比较表的效果与数字解读

paragraphs.text: 2024年考克兰综述纳入209项随机试验，共107,698名面临治疗或筛查选择的成年人。与常规说明相比，决策辅助改善了知识和风险理解，但决策后悔程度没有差异。这证明的是决策过程的改善，并不能证明使用比较表会提高所选治疗的治愈率。应区分决策质量的评价与治疗本身的临床结局。
比较概率时，应统一分母、时间范围和结果定义，例如都写成“每100人在五年内发生的人数”。还应核对估计针对的人群及不确定性。不同分母的数字，或仅用“罕见”“很高”等词语，可能使选项之间的差异看起来失真。不明白的数字可在就诊时询问。

sections.title: 把个人重视的事情带入对话

paragraphs.text: 明确价值观可以通过写出利弊、结构化讨论，也可以打分。涵盖43种方法的试验综述发现，明确梳理个人重视的因素有一定益处，但研究之间存在差异。表格应帮助表达犹豫的原因及优先考虑的事项，不必让总分直接决定最后选择。

decision-aids.auditNote: Examined definitions, value scoring and consultation advice in all three locales. Inspected the PubMed abstracts and verified source titles on opened records; no claim of full-text review. Original statements did not require factual replacement. Added quantified review scope, the distinction between decision quality and treatment efficacy, consistent probability formats, and alternatives to scoring. No decision aid for a specific regenerative intervention was validated.

sources.studyType: 国立がん研究センターの患者会・患者サロン利用案内（2025年12月16日掲載）

sources.title: Effectiveness of Peer Support on Quality of Life and Anxiety in Breast Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.studyType: Systematic review of 14 randomized studies of breast-cancer peer support; 11 studies entered meta-analysis

sources.title: What works in peer support for breast cancer survivors: A qualitative systematic review and meta-ethnography
sources.studyType: Qualitative systematic review and meta-ethnography of 11 articles covering 345 participants

sections.title: 交流の場を選び、体験談を読み分ける

paragraphs.text: がんの患者会は当事者が自主運営するものが多く、患者サロンには病院や自治体が設ける場もあります。目的や参加対象は異なるので、相談支援センターの案内や見学を利用して確かめます。同じ病名でも病状は違うため、体験談だけで治療を選ばず、特定の医療や商品を勧められた場合は医療者に別途確認します。参加を休むことも選択肢です。参加先の目的と自分が求める支援が合うかも確認します。

sections.title: 効果の根拠と負担への配慮

paragraphs.text: 乳がん患者のピアサポートを調べた系統的レビューでは14研究が採用され、11研究の統合で生活の質と不安に改善がみられました。ただし、研究の偏りや結果の不一致により根拠の確実性は低いと評価されています。参加すれば必ず楽になるとはいえず、別の疾患や運営方法の異なる会にそのまま当てはめることもできません。
乳がん経験者345人の経験を扱った11論文の質的レビューでは、理解し合えるつながりの一方、不快な感情への配慮や支援者の研修・監督も課題となりました。参加先を選ぶ際には、つらくなったときの相談相手や進行役の対応方針を確認する視点になります。これは体験の分析であり、効果の大きさを測った試験ではありません。

sections.title: Choose a group and interpret personal stories

paragraphs.text: Cancer patient groups are often member-run, while hospitals or municipalities may host salons. Ask a support center or visit to learn the group’s purpose and participants. The same diagnosis does not mean the same clinical situation; verify treatment or product recommendations separately with healthcare professionals. Taking a break is also an option. Check whether the group’s purpose matches the support you want.

sections.title: Evidence of benefit and emotional burden

paragraphs.text: A breast-cancer review included 14 randomized studies and pooled 11. Quality of life and anxiety improved, but evidence certainty was low because of bias and inconsistent results. Participation cannot guarantee relief, and these findings do not automatically apply to other diseases or differently organized groups.

A qualitative synthesis of 11 articles, representing 345 breast-cancer survivors, described mutual understanding alongside a need to monitor distress and support staff training and supervision. This suggests asking who can help when a session becomes upsetting and how facilitators respond. Qualitative experiences do not quantify treatment effects.

sections.title: 选择交流场所并理解个人经历

paragraphs.text: 癌症患者会常由患者自主运营，患者沙龙也可能由医院或地方政府设立。可通过咨询支援中心或参观了解其目的和参加对象。同一诊断不代表相同病情；涉及治疗或产品的推荐，应另外向医务人员核实，不能仅凭他人的经历选择治疗。暂停参加也是一种选择。还应确认团体的目的是否符合自己需要的支持。

sections.title: 获益证据与情绪负担

paragraphs.text: 一项乳腺癌同伴支持综述纳入14项随机研究，其中11项进行合并分析，生活质量和焦虑有所改善。但由于偏倚和结果不一致，证据确定性被评为低。参加并不保证心情改善，也不能把结果直接推广到其他疾病或组织方式不同的团体。
另一项质性综述汇总11篇论文中345名乳腺癌经历者的体验，既发现相互理解和情感联系，也指出需要关注不愉快的情绪、支持者培训及督导。选择团体时，可了解交流令人难受时向谁求助、主持人如何处理。这类体验分析不能量化治疗效果。

patient-groups.auditNote: Reviewed all three locales for unsupported treatment claims, coercion, privacy and participation advice. No materially false original paragraph identified. Added official distinctions between groups and salons, low-certainty randomized evidence specific to breast cancer, and qualitative evidence about distress and facilitation. Abstract-only research appraisal; neither group quality nor any individual organization was certified.

sources.title: 相談窓口の御案内＜医療相談窓口＞
sources.studyType: 宮城県の医療相談窓口の機能・受付先に関する公式案内

sections.title: 相談窓口の役割と権限を分ける

paragraphs.text: 2026年３月改正の国の運営要領では、医療安全支援センターは患者・住民の苦情や心配に対応し、中立的な立場から問題解決への取り組みを支援します。医療行為の過失、因果関係、責任の所在を決定する機関ではありません。相談員の助言を、治療の正しさや賠償責任を確定する判断と取り違えないことが重要です。院内の対話支援と行政の相談では、担当者の立場も異なります。
自治体の医療相談を申し込んでも、相手の医療機関との交渉や示談が自動的に始まるわけではありません。例えば大阪府は、民事上のトラブルの仲介や診療の是非の判断を支援範囲から区別しています。説明を受けたいのか、別の医師の意見が必要なのか、法的な解決を求めるのかによって、紹介される相談先も変わります。

sections.title: 相談先を選ぶための準備

paragraphs.text: 宮城県の案内では、行政の相談窓口は相談内容の整理、助言、他の窓口の紹介などを行います。この役割を踏まえ、経過と未解決の質問を短くまとめることが相談の準備になります。窓口を探す際は医療機関の所在地や施設の種類などによる担当の違いを確認し、その窓口で対応できる内容と次の連絡先を確かめます。受付方法や対応時間も先に確認しておきます。

sections.title: Separate support from decision-making authority

paragraphs.text: Japan’s March 2026 operating guidance assigns medical safety support centers a neutral role in responding to complaints and concerns. They support efforts to resolve problems but do not decide negligence, causation or responsibility. Advice from a center therefore does not establish whether treatment was correct or compensation is owed. Hospital dialogue support and administrative advice involve different roles.

Contacting a municipal or prefectural service does not automatically start negotiation or settlement with a hospital. Osaka explicitly excludes mediation of civil disputes and judgments about treatment appropriateness. Clarifying whether the concern is an explanation, another medical opinion or a legal remedy helps identify the appropriate referral.

sections.title: Prepare for the right consultation service

paragraphs.text: Miyagi describes its service as helping organize concerns, offering advice and directing people to other desks. A short chronology and a list of unresolved questions are practical preparation for that role. Check the correct office for the facility’s location and type, then clarify what it can handle and where any remaining issue should go. Check access methods and opening hours beforehand.

sections.title: 区分咨询支持与裁定权限

paragraphs.text: 日本2026年3月修订的运营规定要求医疗安全支援中心以中立立场回应投诉与担忧，支持双方解决问题，但不裁定医疗过失、因果关系或责任归属。因此，咨询员的建议不能视为对治疗是否正确或是否应赔偿的正式判断。院内对话支持与行政咨询的工作人员也有不同职责。
向地方政府的医疗咨询窗口求助，并不意味着窗口会自动与医院谈判或促成和解。例如大阪府明确区分民事纠纷调解和诊疗是非判断，这些不属于其具体解决范围。希望获得说明、另一个医生的意见，还是法律解决途径，会影响适合转介的咨询机构。

sections.title: 为选择合适窗口作准备

paragraphs.text: 宫城县说明，行政窗口主要帮助梳理问题、提供建议及介绍其他咨询处。根据这一职能，事先简要整理事情经过和未解决的问题有助于沟通。寻找窗口时，应核对医疗机构所在地及设施类型对应的负责部门，并确认它能处理什么、剩余问题应联系何处。还应提前确认咨询方式及受理时间。

corrections.old: 患者と医療者の対話を促し、行き違いの解消を助ける取り組みです。苦情処理ではなく対話の回復が目的です。
corrections.new: 医療メディエーションは、患者・家族と医療者の対話を支える取り組みです。説明不足への不安や病院への不満も相談のきっかけになります。利用できる担当者や相談方法は、医療機関に確認します。
corrections.reason: The original wrongly presents complaints and dialogue restoration as mutually exclusive. The inspected NHO mediation service expressly includes patients unable to convey dissatisfaction. Avoid implying universal availability or guaranteed resolution.

corrections.old: It promotes dialogue between patients and clinicians to resolve gaps. The goal is restoring dialogue, not handling complaints.
corrections.new: Medical mediation supports dialogue between patients, families and clinicians. Concerns about inadequate explanations or dissatisfaction with a hospital can also be reasons to seek help. Check with the institution about available staff and how to access the service.
corrections.reason: The original wrongly presents complaints and dialogue restoration as mutually exclusive. The inspected NHO mediation service expressly includes patients unable to convey dissatisfaction. Avoid implying universal availability or guaranteed resolution.

corrections.old: 促进患者与医疗者对话，帮助消除分歧。目的不是处理投诉而是恢复对话。
corrections.new: 医疗调解旨在支持患者、家属与医务人员之间的对话。对说明不足感到不安或对医院不满，也可以成为求助的原因。具体负责人员和咨询方式需要向医疗机构确认。
corrections.reason: The original wrongly presents complaints and dialogue restoration as mutually exclusive. The inspected NHO mediation service expressly includes patients unable to convey dissatisfaction. Avoid implying universal availability or guaranteed resolution.

counseling-support.auditNote: Audited all locales against the March 2026 national operating guidance and current prefectural descriptions. Replaced the categorical exclusion of complaints from mediation: the NHO hospital explicitly accepts difficulty expressing dissatisfaction. Distinguished an in-hospital dialogue facilitator from administrative advice, medical second opinions and civil-dispute resolution. Prefectural examples describe their own services, not a nationwide guarantee of identical procedures. No legal outcome or absolute confidentiality guarantee is made.

sources.studyType: 国立がん研究センターの緩和ケアの利用場所、連携、症状の伝え方に関する公式案内

sources.title: Early Specialist Palliative Care in Patients with Metastatic Cancer: A Population-Based Cohort Study
sources.studyType: 2025 retrospective cohort study of 171,224 patients receiving care at participating US hospitals in 2018–2019

sections.title: 症状と生活の両方を支える

paragraphs.text: 緩和ケアは、がんや人生の最終段階だけのものではありません。厚生労働省の循環器疾患に関する報告書は、心不全でも病気の治療と並行して早期から支援する考え方を示しています。痛みや息苦しさに加え、心理面・社会生活の不安も対象です。心不全には悪化と回復を繰り返す経過があり、病状の変化と本人が大切にする生活に合わせて支援を考えます。

sections.title: 利用場所と研究の読み方

paragraphs.text: がん治療中の一般外来・病棟で受ける緩和ケアと、専門外来や緩和ケア病棟の利用は区別します。専門外来がない施設や入院待機が必要な施設もあり、在宅では訪問診療・訪問看護などの調整が必要です。利用を相談するときは、希望する療養場所と症状による生活の支障を伝え、紹介や支援体制を確認します。家族の困りごとも相談の対象です。
米国の参加病院で転移がん患者171,224人を調べた後ろ向き研究では、初回転移診断から８週間以内に専門的緩和ケアを受けた人は8.0％でした。受けた人と受けなかった人では併存疾患などが異なります。この数字は受療状況を示すもので、緩和ケアの効果を無作為に比較した結果でも、日本の利用率を示すものでもありません。

sections.title: Support for symptoms and everyday life

paragraphs.text: Palliative care can accompany disease treatment before the final stage of life. A Japanese MHLW report describes this approach for heart failure, addressing physical symptoms and psychological or social difficulties. Because heart failure can alternate between deterioration and improvement, support should reflect the changing condition and the person’s priorities.

sections.title: Care settings and what access research means

paragraphs.text: Palliative support during ordinary cancer visits or admission differs from accessing a specialist clinic or dedicated ward. Specialist clinics may be unavailable locally, wards may have waiting lists, and home care requires coordination. Discuss the preferred setting and symptoms’ effects on daily life when asking about referrals and available support. Family members can also discuss their support needs.

A US retrospective cohort of 171,224 patients with metastatic cancer found that 8.0% received specialist palliative care within eight weeks of diagnosis. Recipients differed from nonrecipients in factors including comorbidity. This measures service use, not a randomized treatment effect, and it should not be presented as Japan’s access rate.

sections.title: 同时关注症状与日常生活

paragraphs.text: 缓和医疗不只适用于癌症或生命最后阶段。日本厚生劳动省关于循环系统疾病的报告提出，心力衰竭也可以从早期就在疾病治疗的同时获得支持，处理疼痛、气促以及心理和社会生活的困难。心衰可能反复加重和缓解，因此应结合病情变化与本人珍视的生活安排支持。

sections.title: 服务场所与利用情况研究

paragraphs.text: 普通癌症门诊或病房中的缓和支持，与专科门诊或缓和医疗病房的利用并不相同。有些机构没有专科门诊，住院可能需要等待，居家照护也需协调上门诊疗和护理。咨询时应说明希望在哪里疗养、症状如何影响生活，并核实转介和支援安排。家属也可就自己的困难提出咨询。
一项美国回顾性队列研究观察了171,224名转移性癌症患者，其中8.0%在首次转移诊断后八周内接受专科缓和医疗。接受者与未接受者的合并疾病等情况不同。这个数字描述服务利用情况，既不是随机比较疗效的结果，也不能当作日本的利用率。

palliative-care.auditNote: Reviewed all original locales. Added Japanese MHLW guidance on heart-failure palliative care, NCC service distinctions, and the inspected PubMed abstract of a US access cohort. The 2018 report supports the conceptual scope, not a claim about current reimbursement or universal local availability. The cohort describes access, not treatment efficacy or Japanese uptake. This editorial check is not an exhaustive review or an individual care recommendation.

sources.title: 人工膝関節置換術を受けられる　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　様へ
sources.studyType: 国立病院機構大阪南医療センターの患者用クリニカルパス（2018年承認）。病状に応じて予定を変更する旨のみ参照

sections.title: 手術に合う目標と評価を組み立てる

paragraphs.text: リハビリは運動量を増やすことだけが目的ではありません。がん手術の前後では呼吸の練習や早期離床、生活動作への支援などがあり、予想される機能低下と生活上の目標に合わせて計画します。理学療法士だけでなく、着替えなどを支える作業療法士、のみ込みや発声を支える言語聴覚士が関わることもあります。
人工膝関節全置換術に関する2026年の診療指針は、文献の系統的な検討に基づき20の推奨をまとめ、利益・害、実施可能性、本人の希望を扱っています。これは一つの運動を比較した試験ではありません。抄録だけでは個々の運動の強さや順序は確認できないため、この資料から自己流の訓練手順を作らず、手術内容に合う計画と評価方法を担当者に確認します。

sections.title: 自宅と入院のリハビリを比較する

paragraphs.text: オーストラリアのHIHO試験では、合併症のない人工膝関節全置換術後の165人を無作為に割り付けました。専門職が確認する自宅プログラムに10日間の入院リハビリを追加しても、26週後の歩行能力に有意差はありませんでした。これは支援付きの自宅療養との比較であり、リハビリ不要という意味でも、複雑な術後経過の人まで自宅が適切という意味でもありません。

sections.title: Build goals and assessment around the operation

paragraphs.text: Rehabilitation is more than increasing exercise volume. Around cancer surgery it may include breathing preparation, early mobilization and daily-activity support, matched to anticipated impairment and personal goals. Occupational therapists may help with dressing and other tasks, while speech-language-hearing therapists address swallowing or communication; physical therapy is one part of this work.

A 2026 guideline for total knee arthroplasty reports 20 recommendations based on a systematic literature review, considering benefits, harms, feasibility and patient preferences. It is not a trial of one exercise. Its abstract does not establish individual exercise doses or sequencing; discuss an operation-specific plan and assessment methods with the rehabilitation team.

sections.title: Compare home and inpatient rehabilitation

paragraphs.text: The Australian HIHO trial randomized 165 adults after uncomplicated total knee replacement. Adding ten inpatient rehabilitation days to a monitored home program did not significantly improve walking capacity at 26 weeks. The comparator still included professional monitoring; the finding does not mean rehabilitation is unnecessary or home care suits complicated recovery.

sections.title: 按手术内容制定目标和评估

paragraphs.text: 康复不只是增加运动量。癌症手术前后可能包括呼吸训练、早期离床和日常动作支持，并根据预期功能变化及生活目标制定计划。除物理治疗师外，作业治疗师可帮助穿衣等活动，言语听觉治疗师可处理吞咽或交流问题，各专业的任务有所不同。
2026年人工全膝关节置换术诊疗指南基于系统文献检讨提出20项推荐，并考虑获益、危害、可行性及患者意愿。这不是比较某一种运动的试验。仅凭摘要无法确认各项训练的强度或顺序，因此不宜据此自行制定训练流程，而应与康复团队确认适合手术情况的计划和评价方法。

sections.title: 比较居家与住院康复

paragraphs.text: 澳大利亚HIHO试验将165名全膝置换术后无并发症的成年人随机分组。在专业人员监测的居家计划之外增加十天住院康复，未显著改善26周时的步行能力。比较组仍有专业监测，因此不能解释为不需要康复，也不能推断术后情况复杂者都适合居家恢复。

corrections.old: 可動域、筋力、持久力の順に負荷を上げます。痛みや腫れの合図を見ながら調整します。
corrections.new: リハビリの進行は、手術内容や病状に合わせた担当チームの計画に沿って調整します。可動域、筋力、持久力を必ずこの順番で進めるとは限りません。痛みなどの変化を伝え、予定の変更が必要か確認します。
corrections.reason: The original asserts an unsupported sequence for all operations. The inspected hospital pathway combines postoperative activities and explicitly allows changes according to clinical condition; a universal exercise progression cannot be inferred.

corrections.old: Raise loads in order of range, strength, and endurance. Adjust watching pain and swelling signals.
corrections.new: Progress according to the treating team’s plan for the operation and clinical condition. Range of motion, strength and endurance do not have to follow a fixed sequence. Report changes such as pain so the team can reassess the schedule.
corrections.reason: The original asserts an unsupported sequence for all operations. The inspected hospital pathway combines postoperative activities and explicitly allows changes according to clinical condition; a universal exercise progression cannot be inferred.

corrections.old: 按活动度、肌力与耐力顺序加负荷。看疼痛肿胀信号调整。
corrections.new: 康复进度应按负责团队针对手术内容及病情制定的计划调整，并非必须按活动度、肌力、耐力的固定顺序推进。应反馈疼痛等变化，由团队评估是否需要修改安排。
corrections.reason: The original asserts an unsupported sequence for all operations. The inspected hospital pathway combines postoperative activities and explicitly allows changes according to clinical condition; a universal exercise progression cannot be inferred.

sections.title: 治療内容に合わせる歯科との連携

paragraphs.text: がん治療中は、病気や治療による抵抗力の低下で、むし歯や歯肉の感染が重くなることがあります。歯科には治療内容を伝え、歯みがき方法や義歯の管理を個別に確認します。化学療法中のフロスや歯間ブラシは出血の問題があるため、普段使っていても使用を続けてよいか相談が必要です。
頭頸部への放射線治療歴は、治療終了後も歯科に伝える重要な情報です。口腔がんの解説では、放射線の影響は長く残り、数年後の抜歯が下顎骨の骨髄炎につながる場合もあるとされています。歯科処置の可否や時期は担当医と歯科医が調整し、全員が治療前にすべての処置を終えるという一律の考え方は避けます。

sections.title: 口を傷つけず、食べる機能も守る

paragraphs.text: 口内炎があるときは、痛む部分を強くこすらず、清潔と保湿を保つ方法を相談します。熱い食べ物や強い刺激を避け、合わない義歯、飲み込みにくさ、食事がしみるなどの変化を早めに伝えます。これらはがん治療の支持療法に関する情報であり、すべての再生医療で同じ頻度の口腔障害が起こるという意味ではありません。
口の清潔だけでは、飲み込む機能の問題は解決できません。口腔がんの手術後には、切除部位や回復状態に応じて、言語聴覚士や管理栄養士を含む支援が必要になることがあります。むせや食べにくさがある場合は、自己流で食形態や姿勢を決めず、口腔ケアと嚥下の評価を分けて相談します。

sections.title: Coordinate dental care with the treatment plan

paragraphs.text: During cancer treatment, reduced resistance to infection can make dental or gum infections more serious. Tell the dental team about treatment and review brushing and denture care. Floss and interdental brushes can cause bleeding during chemotherapy, so their continued use needs discussion even when they were part of the usual routine.

A history of head and neck radiotherapy remains relevant to dental care after treatment ends. NCC guidance describes persistent radiation effects and mandibular osteomyelitis following extraction even years later. The treating clinician and dentist should coordinate procedures and timing; completing every dental procedure before medical treatment is not a universal requirement.

sections.title: Protect the mouth and swallowing function

paragraphs.text: With mouth sores, discuss cleaning and moisture measures that avoid rubbing painful areas. Report burning with food, difficulty swallowing or ill-fitting dentures early, and avoid very hot or irritating foods. This guidance concerns supportive care during cancer treatment; it does not establish that every regenerative treatment causes oral problems at the same rate.

Cleaning alone does not resolve impaired swallowing. After oral cancer surgery, rehabilitation may involve speech and language therapists and dietitians according to the operation and recovery. Coughing during meals or difficulty eating warrants a separate swallowing assessment; texture and posture changes should be individualized rather than improvised.

sections.title: 根据治疗方案协调牙科护理

paragraphs.text: 癌症或其治疗可能降低抵抗力，使蛀牙、牙龈感染变得更严重。应向牙科团队说明治疗情况，个别确认刷牙方法及义齿护理。化疗期间牙线和牙缝刷可能引起出血，即使平时一直使用，也应先询问能否继续使用。
头颈部放疗史在治疗结束后仍是牙科需要了解的重要信息。国立癌症研究中心指出，放射线影响可能长期存在，数年后拔牙也可能引发下颌骨骨髓炎。牙科操作及时间应由主治医生与牙医协调，不能一概要求所有患者在治疗前完成全部牙科处理。

sections.title: 保护口腔与吞咽功能

paragraphs.text: 出现口腔黏膜炎时，应商量既保持清洁、湿润又避免用力摩擦痛处的方法。进食刺痛、吞咽困难或义齿不合适等变化应及早报告，并避免过热或刺激性食物。这些资料针对癌症治疗中的支持护理，不代表各种再生医疗都会以相同频率造成口腔问题。
保持口腔清洁本身不能解决吞咽功能障碍。口腔癌术后可能需要言语治疗师、营养师等按切除部位及恢复情况参与康复。进食呛咳或吃东西困难时，应将吞咽评估与口腔清洁分别咨询，食物质地和进食姿势需个别确定。

corrections.old: 口の細菌は誤嚥性肺炎や全身の感染につながります。治療前後の口腔ケアは合併症予防の一環です。
corrections.new: 口腔内の細菌は、状況によって誤嚥性肺炎や全身感染に関わることがあります。口腔ケアはリスクを減らすための対策の一つですが、合併症を必ず防げるわけではありません。
corrections.reason: The English version states causation and prevention as certainties; equivalent wording is qualified in all locales to avoid deterministic infection claims.

corrections.old: Mouth bacteria lead to aspiration pneumonia and systemic infection. Oral care around treatment prevents complications.
corrections.new: Oral bacteria can contribute to aspiration pneumonia or systemic infection in some circumstances. Oral care is one measure to reduce risk, but it cannot guarantee prevention of complications.
corrections.reason: The English version states causation and prevention as certainties; equivalent wording is qualified in all locales to avoid deterministic infection claims.

corrections.old: 口腔细菌通向误吸性肺炎与全身感染。治疗前后口腔护理是并发症预防一环。
corrections.new: 在特定情况下，口腔细菌可能参与引发误吸性肺炎或全身感染。口腔护理是降低风险的措施之一，但不能保证预防所有并发症。
corrections.reason: The English version states causation and prevention as certainties; equivalent wording is qualified in all locales to avoid deterministic infection claims.

corrections.old: むし歯や歯周病の治療、歯石の除去を済ませます。抜歯が必要な場合は時期を調整します。
corrections.new: 治療前に口腔内を評価し、必要な歯科処置とその時期を担当医・歯科医で調整します。抜歯などを全員が先に済ませるという意味ではありません。
corrections.reason: Blanket instructions to finish dental treatment omit treatment-specific risks and coordination, particularly after head and neck radiotherapy.

corrections.old: Finish cavity and gum treatment and tartar removal. Time extractions as needed.
corrections.new: Arrange an oral assessment before treatment and coordinate necessary dental procedures and timing with the treating clinician and dentist. Not everyone needs extractions or all dental work completed first.
corrections.reason: Blanket instructions to finish dental treatment omit treatment-specific risks and coordination, particularly after head and neck radiotherapy.

corrections.old: 处理完蛀牙牙周与牙石。需拔牙调整时期。
corrections.new: 治疗前评估口腔状况，由主治医生与牙医协调所需处理和时间；这并不意味着每个人都必须先拔牙或完成全部牙科治疗。
corrections.reason: Blanket instructions to finish dental treatment omit treatment-specific risks and coordination, particularly after head and neck radiotherapy.

oral-care-during.auditNote: Inspected Japanese NCC patient guidance on infection, mucositis, oral-cancer radiotherapy and rehabilitation. Corrected deterministic infection/prevention language and blanket completion of dental work in all locales. Evidence is mainly cancer supportive-care guidance, not proof of benefit or equal oral risk for every regenerative intervention; no clinician review or comprehensive safety assessment was performed.
